moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-aurora-text, written here): Colour layer clipped to the letters: a tinted base plus 4 soft radial blobs (accent, cyan, green, yellow; radius 0.42 × text width, min 46 px) orbiting on Lissajous paths (x ±0.42 w, y ±0.6 h, rates 1× / 2× of a 6 s cycle). The whole layer rotates −5° ↔ +5° and scales 0.9 ↔ 1.1 as −cos, period 3 s (two per 6 s loop); letters still. CSS fallback: 135° gradient of 5 stops (first = last), size 200 %, background-position 0 → 100 → 0 % over 8 s ease-in-out. Params: colors: bốn màu cực quang · cycle: chu kỳ trôi (6 s) · rotate (±5°) · scale (0.9 ↔ 1.1). Four soft blobs on Lissajous paths (1× and 2× the cycle), the layer turning ±5° and breathing 0.9 ↔ 1.1; the letters stay still.
